chunk_text: PISCES ASCENDANT.. Saturn, Venus, the Sun and Mercury are malefics. Saturn owns two evil houses for pisces ascendant. Hence he will reveal himself most awfully. Venus rules the 3rd and 8th--again two evil houses. And hence he is not a favourable planet. The sun ruling the 6th will prove adverse though he has good terms with the lord of the ascendant, Jupiter.
Mars and the Moon are auspicious. Mars is the lord of the 2nd (Moolatrikona) and the 9th (the best of the trines).
Mars and Jupiter will cause a yoga. Jupiter is a very favourable planet (of course next to Mars) owning the ascendant and the 10th.

Though Mars is a killer, he will not kill the native (independently). Inspite of owning a killer-house, he has been specifically exempt from acting as a killer independently and placed in the yogakaraka list. To be a killer, Mars must be instigated by another killer. viz. Saturn or Mercury.
Saturn and Mercury are killers. Thus should be judged the effects for a Pisces native.

GENERAL .. Thus the auspicious and inauspicious effects derivable through the planets due to their lordships according to the rising sign be estimated. Apart, the effects due to Nabhasa yogas etc, be also known. To wit, if a planet is a constituent of a favourable yoga, like, say, Daamini Yoga (one of the Nabhasa Yogas), his original malefic tendency of being an adverse planet for a particular ascendant, he will give the effects of Daamini yoga and thus will become a Rajayogakaraka.

chunk_text: Conversely, although a planet assumes a good role by lordship, if he is involved in a bad yoga, like, say, Sarpa yoga (one of the Nabhasa yogas again) there will only be adverse results and not favourable results due to lordship.
